decision_rule: Read four exact-digest retained KPF-64 CPU server logs. Aggregate only single-save prompt-cache update blocks and report total, excluded, and eligible counts, plus median/min/max of saved-state bytes divided by enclosing update elapsed time by arm. Refuse changed, oversized, malformed or missing input, STOP or deadline. This inclusive historical effective rate may include allocation, search, checkpoint and load overhead; it is not pure copy bandwidth, restore speed, controlled timing, or HSF-4 completion.
